notes.title: Halloween possesses Manning Manor with a new Update! 🎃
notes.content:
Spooky greetings everyone! Halloween is around the corner, and Manning Manor got possessed by the ghosts of "All Hallows' Eve". Maybe a certain Jack O'Lantern hides inside the not so abandoned mansion as well... So update [b]Silver Chains[/b] and enter Manning Manor, if you dare!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34364455/211e9338d5fc4cf51f96e2531928d2737cf410c7.jpg[/img]

[b]Silver Chains[/b] is part of the [b]Steam Halloween Sale[/b] taking place from today! So, if you haven't spent Mommy a visit yet, you should definitely do it [b]with 25% OFF![/b] Or Mommy would be really mad at you...

👻 Happy Halloween to the world! 🎃

notes.title: Silver Chains Update #2 incl. Trading Cards Is Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34364455/2fb51e8a96df4675090483b0d9da1304bb7bf728.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, we are very happy to announce that we have added Steam Trading Cards to the game! You can now collect trading cards, profile backgrounds, badges and emoticons while playing [b]Silver Chains[/b].

[b]We have also made some small improvements to the game:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the SteamVR
[*]Fixed another bug related to the statue heads
[/list]
We will of course keep you posted on our next steps and updates. Thank you all!
Team Cracked Heads Games & Headup

notes.title: First Silver Chains Update Is Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34364455/21cd2b5d63f54f5479106e1189eceedb56355afb.jpg[/img]

To our amazing community! First of all, we’d like to say thank you for the great feedback and all the input you provided us with throughout the past 24 hours. That said, we are taking the community’s feedback very seriously and work very hard to improve your experiences!

[b]Here is a short overview on the improvements that come with our first update:[/b]
[list]
[*] We have fixed an issue with the statue head (It now correctly disappears after using it)
[*] When in the attic, some players did not notice the aconite laying on the book, the exit is now closed until the aconite has been collected
[*] In the final battle, we decided to change the coloring of the amulets when players look through the monocle so that the amulets and important objects stand out from the interior
[/list]

We will of course keep you posted on our next steps and updates. Thank you all!

Team Cracked Heads Games & Headup

Colesy is on his way right NOW to explore the decayed building and give you a short peek into what is waiting for you inside this old manor, where the shadows seem darker than anywhere else...

notes.title: Live-Stream: Sneak into the Home of Horror #2!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34364455/40517ac44eb91fab0b58ddf32988bd594889bb36.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Morgen ist Muttertag - seid ihr vorbereitet?[/b][/h1]

Mit dem morgigen Release von [b]Silver Chains[/b] wird Mami auf auch aufpassen - ob ihr nun wollt, oder nicht! Wie wäre es mit einem kurzen Einblick auf das, was euch in den dunklen Schatten von Manning Manor erwartet? Schaut euch unseren Live-Stream hier auf der Steam-Produktseite an - los geht's um 17.30 Uhr!

Der deutsche Streamer [b]rinderhackTV[/b] wird euch zeigen, was euch in den ersten 30 Minuten in [b]Silver Chains[/b] erwartet...



[h1][b]Guys, Mother's Day is damn close - hope you are prepared![/b][/h1]

With the release of [b]Silver Chains[/b] tomorrow, Mommy will be watching you... Whether you like it or not! Wanna take a peek of what's waiting for you in the dark shadows of Manning Manor? Then follow our Live-Stream at 5.30pm (CET) / 8.30am (PST) here on the Steam product page!

German streamer [b]rinderhackTV[/b] aka Joe will give you a closer look on what the first 30 minutes of [b]Silver Chains[/b] could look like...
